sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2024
sources.text: While underway, two perpetrators armed with knives were sighted in the engine room. The master raised general alarm and all crew mustered safely in the wheelhouse. The crew did not conduct search but wait for PCG’s assistance. There were no injuries. Some spare parts were stolen. The ship agent reported the incident to the Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) via telephone. Safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force
